title: What's new in 1.0.1
description:
• Photo uploader / subscribe URLs now point at the right host
• Native theme picker adds a Blue option
• Trial offer can be opted out of from CC
• Immich account picker scrim + sign-out + re-auth

• HA back-button user-opt-in toggle
• D.79 / D.80 / D.84 fixes
